summary: Tested no-login AniEmotion (X-Client-Id scoping) + emotion parametrization. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass (missing/invalid X-Client-Id -> 400, per-client isolation, PNG images for owner / 404 for others, upload validation, speech tiny chunk). Frontend: app opens straight into Studio (no Clerk/sign-in), 3 nav tabs work; with clientId=test-client-0001 live tab shows all 6 avatar layers loaded as blobs; emotion-settings-panel has 4 cards (switch + gain + threshold) and 6 global sliders; keyboard/mouse slider changes update numbers, switch disables sliders, values persist to localStorage across reload, reset restores defaults (also after reload). Gallery shows 3 cards (1 ready + 2 failed) with select/delete buttons; select returns to live. Fresh browser auto-generates UUID clientId, lands on create tab, generate disabled until file picked, style pill toggles, generation fails with friendly toast 'Brak środków na kluczu AI — doładuj saldo ...' (no crash). Camera/mic buttons render (disabled when no avatar); webcam/speech not testable headless.

minor.issue: Only deletes Mongo doc; stored photo/PNG objects remain in object storage (orphans).
STT budget-exhausted error returns generic 502 'Nie udało się rozpoznać mowy' rather than the friendly 'Brak środków' message used for generation; LLM classify failure silently returns neutral.

integration_issues.issue: After a generation fails, Studio.load() is not called (onReady only on ready), so the failed avatar does not appear in Gallery until page reload.

issues: Emotion thumbnail row uses 4x w-1/4 + gap-1, overflowing card image width by ~12px (4th thumb sticks out right).
Failed cards only show 'Nieudane' without the stored error reason; disabled 'Użyj' button still looks prominent.

action_items: Call load() (or a callback) when generation status becomes 'failed' so Gallery reflects it
Fix gallery thumbnail row overflow (use grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 or flex-1 instead of w-1/4)
Optional: map budget errors in /api/speech/analyze to the friendly Polish message; delete storage objects on avatar delete; add delete confirmation
critical_code_review_comments: LiveStudio.loadParams does shallow merge: if stored emotionParams lacks an emotion key or has older schema, nested emotions object is replaced wholesale (could miss a new emotion). Consider deep merge with DEFAULT_PARAMS.emotions.
X-Client-Id is the only access control; anyone knowing an id can read its avatars (acceptable for no-login design, but ids should stay random UUIDs).
useAvatarImages swallows all image fetch errors silently (catch(() => {})) - no error state shown.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_avatars_api.py (rewritten from Clerk Bearer tokens to X-Client-Id)
seed_data_creation: One failed avatar created under a random auto-generated clientId by the fresh-browser generation test; ready avatar e9d73202 untouched.

LLM budget exhausted -> generation fails with 'Brak środków' toast. Sliders are Radix: focus [data-testid=...] [role=slider] and use arrow keys; value text is span.font-mono in parent div.
